limitations: Broader suggested tags, recent/children/related/lookup and Options parents remain Partial. No aliases or additional leaf counts.

Related/lookup panels, weights/durations and complete suggestion-list keyboard/context menus are outside this width/layout packet. Their availability/default selection and separately banked related-tag weight editor receive no additional credit here.
Recent history is a real read/add consumer; Clear confirmation/read-time decay and recent settings editor remain unimplemented.

Native per-service editing uses an owned selection/list window and shared write-tag child instead of embedding the original input directly in Options. Existing write-autocomplete consumers/limitations are retained.

Only already-present most-used panels broadcast updates, as Qt; native polls persisted settings every200ms and captures layout/availability at opening. No remote/IPFS fetching or uploads; lists can retain imported real service keys.

Exactly the width and notebook/side-by-side layout leaves are approved; broader suggested-tag/Options parents, aliases, default-page, recent/related/lookup and most-used-editor completion receive no additional credit.

Physical list width has no dedicated measurement observer. The240 opening preference and intrinsic source constraints do not establish a measured rendered240px list width; Qt likewise sets a minimum width, and native lists can stretch.

Manage Tags captures width, layout and availability when opened. Existing owners retain opening preferences; only already-present most-used panels observe persisted broadcasts, using the native200ms observer. Existing Cancel/stale-owner/persistence assertions remain intact.
Recent is a real persisted read/add consumer and current/pending-on-all filter. Clear confirmation, read-time decay and recent settings editor remain outside this packet.

Native per-service editing uses an owned selection/list window and shared write-tag child rather than Qt inline Options editing; existing write-autocomplete limitations remain. No remote/IPFS fetching or uploads are covered; imported real service keys can be retained.

Qt columns PNG is postactivation and includes Clear; native columns PNG is preactivation. The fresh notebook follows preserved Apply/broadcast assertions and retains their additional row in its inactive most-used model. Full-dialog topology and whole-window pixel equality are not claimed; no direct matching Qt Options/notebook PNG exists.
Fresh native columns show parity: without the kanji glyph, while Qt renders parity:漢字; Unicode row/draft data assertions remain. Font/framework/glyph parity is outside these width/layout leaves.
Validation is Linux only; Windows and macOS are deferred. No fade, renderer, parent, alias or broader-family completion credit is granted.

updates.assessment: The original notebook/side-by-side choice stages, persists and reopens. A real Manage Tags consumer displays most-used/recent as selected notebook pages or adjacent columns with actual independent lists, context filtering and staged add-only activation. Already-open dialogs retain their opening layout, matching reference construction.
